questions.question: Which AI tool is best for creating presentations from text?
questions.explanation: Gamma (gamma.app) is specifically designed for AI-generated presentations. Describe your topic and it creates complete slides.

questions.question: What is Perplexity AI best used for?
questions.explanation: Perplexity is an AI search engine that always provides citations and sources — great for research and fact-checking.

questions.question: Which technique tells AI to act as a specific expert?
questions.explanation: Role prompting: 'Act as a senior web developer and review my code.' Gives AI a specific expertise perspective.

questions.question: What is the best format to save a logo designed in Canva?
options: SVG or PNG with transparent background
questions.explanation: SVG is best for logos (scalable, never blurry). PNG with transparent background is the next best option.

questions.question: What makes a good AI image prompt?
questions.explanation: Good image prompts include: Subject (what), Style (art/photo/3D), Details (specifics), Mood (feeling), and Lighting.

questions.question: What is chain prompting?
options: Breaking complex tasks into step-by-step prompts
questions.explanation: Chain prompting breaks a complex task into smaller sequential prompts — each step builds on the previous one.

questions.question: Which tool removes image backgrounds with one click?
questions.explanation: Both Canva (Background Remover feature) and Remove.bg can remove image backgrounds with one click.

questions.question: What should you always do before submitting AI-generated content?
questions.explanation: Always review and edit AI output. Add your own voice, check facts, and personalize before using it.

questions.question: GitHub Copilot is an AI tool for:
questions.explanation: GitHub Copilot is an AI coding assistant that auto-completes code, suggests functions, and helps write code in VS Code.

questions.question: What is Canva's Magic Design feature?
options: AI that creates a complete design from your description
questions.explanation: Magic Design lets you describe what you want and Canva's AI creates a complete design with layout, colors, and images.

questions.question: For AI image generation, 'bokeh' refers to:
questions.explanation: Bokeh is the blurred background effect in photography. Adding 'bokeh' to image prompts creates a professional photo look.

questions.question: Which is NOT a good practice when using AI tools?
options: Using AI to learn new concepts
questions.explanation: Never copy-paste AI output without reviewing. Always check for errors, add your perspective, and personalize the content.
